summary: On the last screen of Get started, each box that cannot show a figure yet now says what it is really waiting for, such as your savings, what you spend each month, or what comes in. A Social Security payment that has already ended no longer counts as something we know, so you are asked for it again.
points: Old catch-all words like "Needs Social Security and birth dates" are gone
If nobody is working, the left-over box says it needs what comes in, not your pay
The retirement box links straight to the question it is missing

summary: The first question in Get started now ends its state list with "I live outside the U.S.". Pick it and the app stops filling in typical U.S. figures and stops asking for a state; picking a state later undoes it.
points: Typical U.S. figures already filled in are taken out; anything you typed stays
The summary reads "outside the U.S." and no state tax row appears
The save message tells you to type your own figures when you have them

summary: A status post says the smart-guesses work is finished and its claim is released, with a hand-over file listing what other pages still need.
A new claim row reserves the follow-up pages from the smart-guesses work and the next retirement fix, so other builders stay out of them.
